description: Inline ADF media placeholders (attachment:<key>) stay in the exported Markdown when JIRA_DOWNLOAD_ATTACHMENTS is off, or when the attachment is skipped/failed, producing broken image references. Resolve inline media independently of the full attachment export, and fall back to the Jira URL when a download does not happen.

title: Improve jira-markdown-export: audit plans
description: Parent for the 12 implementation plans produced by the improve audit on 2026-08-26 (commit dff4ba2). Execution order, dependency graph, status table, and rejected findings live in plans/README.md. Each child bead maps to one plans/NNN-*.md file; executors read the plan fully and update both the bead and the README status row.

title: Handle sanitizeDir/sanitizeFilename collisions deterministically
description: Two issues with the same summary under the same parent produce the same directory or filename, so one silently overwrites the other. Make generated paths unique and deterministic (e.g. include the issue key in the name, or append a suffix on collision) and ensure links still resolve; add a layout test covering the collision.

title: Retry transient network errors and report expired sessions clearly
description: REST calls fail hard on transient errors (5xx, 429, network resets). Add bounded retry with backoff for those cases. If the session expires mid-run (401/403 or a login redirect), abort with a clear message telling the user to delete/refresh the saved session instead of a raw error.

title: Accept multiple issue keys and a --jql option on the CLI
description: Single-issue mode takes exactly one key/URL and JQL is only configurable via JIRA_JQL in .env. Support 'npm run export -- ABC-1 ABC-2 ...' and '--jql "..."' so scope can be chosen per run without editing .env. Keep existing validation of keys/URLs before touching output.

title: Export sprint, epic link, story points, and fix version fields
description: Add sprint, epic link, story points, and fixVersions to the exported field list and render them in generateIssueMd (and frontmatter once it exists). Sprint and story points are custom fields whose IDs vary per instance; resolve them via /rest/api/3/field by name or allow configuration via env.

title: Render issue links with direction and target summaries
description: Related Issues currently prints '<key>: <link type>' with no direction or context. Render inward/outward direction ('blocks ABC-9 – Login flow' / 'is blocked by ...') using the link type's inward/outward names, include the target summary, and use relative Markdown links when the target is part of the export.

title: Render comments as a conversation instead of 'Comment 1/2/3'
description: Comments are currently emitted as numbered '### Comment N' blocks with author/date lines. Render them as a readable thread (e.g. '### <author> — <date>' followed by body), preserving chronological order. Consider an option to skip automation/bot comments.

title: Add YAML frontmatter with labels, components, and Jira URL to issue files
description: Issue Markdown files render metadata as prose, and labels/components are fetched but never written. Add YAML frontmatter (key, type, status, priority, assignee, labels, components, parent, created, updated, Jira URL) to every issue file so agents and tools can filter and reason over cards without parsing headings. Keep the existing heading/prose body.

title: Refresh AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md project guidance
description: Audit both agent guidance files against the live Jira exporter, synchronize current commands, architecture, configuration, verification, and operational safeguards, and preserve managed Beads sections.
acceptance_criteria: AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md accurately describe current project behavior; substantive project guidance is consistent; npm test, node --check export-issues.js, and git diff --check pass.
close_reason: Updated AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md to match current commands, configuration, architecture, safeguards, and verification; all 108 tests and static checks pass.

title: Split export-issues.js into focused modules

Split into modules (e.g. adf.js, jira-client.js, layout.js, attachments.js) with export-issues.js as the entry point. Tests are already organised by concern; keep behaviour identical and update imports in test/.

title: ADF container children are still dropped silently in some cases
description: Plan 006 made unknown top-level ADF *blocks* visible as HTML comments, but three container cases still drop children with no marker: (1) descriptionToMd's taskList case filters to type==='taskItem', so a nested taskList (Jira lets you indent a checklist) vanishes; (2) mediaSingle/mediaGroup filter to type==='media', so a media caption vanishes; (3) blockquote still maps children through processParagraph, so a list or code block inside a quote vanishes (pre-existing, predates plan 006). Fix by recursing or emitting the same '<!-- unsupported ADF block -->' marker. Found by independent review of the plan 006 branch.
